positions.title: Working Student - AI in Formal Verification
Thesis Student - AI for Neuroimaging
positions.description:
- Working on a multi-modal deep learning approach to detect small brain alterations caused by repetitive head impacts in athletes.
- The model uses MR Elastography, MR Spectroscopy, Diffusion Tensor Imaging, and other such modalities to create a sensitive detection method.
- The model focuses on combining modalities into a latent space in an interpretable manner.

positions.title: Data Scientist II
positions.description:
- Worked with a small team to create and deploy large scale state-of-the-art solutions for contactless health monitoring using ballistocardiography.
- Reduce the cleaning and preproceesing time of the collected clinical data from the blood pressure study by 300%.
- Worked on a one-of-a-kind solution for low ejection fraction screening with multi-modal neural networks and Convolutional LSTMs. 
- Increased the range of heart rate calculation algorithm by 30% while retaining FDA standard precision with anomaly detection methods like DB-Scan and FB-Prophet.

positions.title: Junior Data Scientist
positions.description:

- Improved over the accuracy of state-of-the-art infarction detection algorihtm by 2X using a novel multi label classification method.

positions.title: Project Intern
positions.description:

- Improved the speed by 25% and the mAP by 2% for vehicle detection.
- Worked on several other alternatives using FRD-CNN and SpineNet.

positions.title: Machine Learning Intern

positions.title: Technical Head
